title: Home the remaining nine inventoried rules with ids and applied_at
action: Per D4, finish the migration: ticket 004 rows 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 (rows 1, 2, 4 were homed by koh-4 — follow their exact shape). All nine are discipline rules, so the home is AGENTS.md: wrap each live rule in `<!-- rule: agents-<slug> -->` … `<!-- /rule -->` (ids: agents-never-build-on-red, agents-never-zero-execution-workers, agents-capture-line-at-close, agents-context-handoff-65, agents-gates-never-self-approved, agents-one-commit-per-cell, agents-review-user-invoked, agents-one-next-action, agents-worktree-first), and record each home's applied_at under the 'AGENTS.md rule homes' section of docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md plus its frontmatter applied_at key, the way koh-4 did for agents-proof-at-cap. Every other site the ticket lists for that row shrinks to at most one line carrying `(rule: <id>)`. Resolve the drifts the ticket names by citing the home, never by keeping a second wording: row 3 (five scopes of never-build-on-red — AGENTS.md:95 is the fullest, the others point), row 5 (three subjects under one phrase — keep 'never zero execution workers' as the rule; helper-classes-and-transports.md and gates-and-delegation.md rename their own sentences so they no longer reuse the phrase), row 8 (bee-herding requires gate_bypass full/total — add one cross-reference line in each direction, herding's README/role-dispatch pointing at the rule id and the rule's home naming herding as the recorded exception), row 12 (exemption list differs per site — the home carries the one list; routing-and-contracts.md and scout-and-ticks.md point). Row 7: only swarming-reference.md keeps the HANDOFF.json schema (it is mechanism, not a copy); other sites point. lane-and-working-discipline.md:100-115 and :185-195 carry three stacked amendment notes — collapse them to the live rule text plus one 'superseded notes' line citing the decision ids. ALSO FIX (found by koh-10): skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md:79 spells `(rule: R138, docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/gates.md)` — R138 is a spec rule number, not a homed rule id, so knowledge check reports unknown_rule_ref; rewrite that pointer without the `(rule: ...)` form (e.g. 'see gates.md R138'). The `(rule: <id>)` form is reserved for marker-homed ids. Do not touch packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md by hand — it is rendered from AGENTS.md by the regen chain; run `bee dev regen` at the end (skills/ and AGENTS renders are manifest roots). Exit: `bee knowledge check` reports zero duplicate_rule_home / unknown_rule_ref / applied_at_unlinked / dangling_applied_at, and `rg -n '\(rule: '` resolves every pointer to a marker in AGENTS.md or a concept.
